project_type: .NET 8.0 C# library for multi-provider database operations
build_system: dotnet CLI (MSBuild), solution file DBTools.sln with two projects: DBTools (library) and DBToolsUnitTest (tests)
test_framework: MSTest (Microsoft.VisualStudio.TestTools.UnitTesting) with TestBase base class, uses [TestClass]/[TestMethod] attributes
verification_instructions: Build the solution and run unit tests. Since dotnet SDK is not available in the sandbox, verify via code correctness and consistency checks.
setup_instructions: dotnet SDK 8.0+ required. No external packages can be installed (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode).
environment_constraints: dotnet SDK is NOT installed in this sandbox. Network mode is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - cannot install NuGet packages. All implementations must use only System.* and Microsoft.Extensions.* libraries already referenced in the project. Verification is limited to code review and AST-level correctness checks (grep for syntax errors, missing usings, etc.).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: interfaces in Abstractions/, implementations in appropriate subdirectories, tests in DBToolsUnitTest/ mirroring the source structure. Use XML documentation comments. Support all 4 providers where applicable.
key_patterns: 1) Interface-first design: all features exposed via interfaces in DBTools/Abstractions/. 2) Provider abstraction via IDbProvider for multi-db support. 3) AsyncSqlClient is the primary modern client (IAsyncSqlClient). 4) DI registration in ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddDbTools(). 5) Interceptor pipeline (IQueryInterceptor/IAsyncQueryInterceptor) with BeforeExecute/AfterExecute/OnError. 6) DbToolsOptions for configuration. 7) Tests use TestBase with ExecuteInTempDirectory helper. 8) Provider-specific packages loaded via reflection (Npgsql, MySqlConnector, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite).
directory_structure: DBTools/ - main library (Abstractions/, Bulk/, Configuration/, Context/, Controllers/, Core/, Export/, Interceptors/, Linq/, Mapping/, Models/, Properties/, Providers/). DBToolsUnitTest/ - unit tests mirroring source structure (Controllers/, Core/, Export/, Integration/, Linq/, Models/, Providers/). Root has DBTools.sln.
